scripts.text:
[Mark]
It's dangerous here.
It would be better to come back next time when we are stronger.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
这里很危险。
最好等下次我们变强了再来。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Unlike the other doors we saw this door has traces of it being blocked from this side.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
与我们之前看到的门不同，这扇门上有从这一侧被堵住的痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Is there something inside?
scripts.translation:
[马克]
里面有什么东西吗？

scripts.text:
...It doesn't feel right here.
It may be dangerous alone so it might be better to form a party.
scripts.translation:
...这里感觉不对劲。
一个人去可能很危险，最好组个队伍。

scripts.text: Go in.
scripts.translation: 进入

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I'm opening the door.
Go in when the door is completely open.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
我要开门了。
等门完全打开后再进去。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
...feel very suspicious!
It's a little dangerous to be alone. It is recommended to team up!
scripts.translation:
[马克]
...感觉很可疑！
一个人有点危险，建议组队！

scripts.text:
[Mark]
The door does not seem to be fully open.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
门似乎没有完全打开。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hey... what is going on?
scripts.translation:
[马克]
嘿...这是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Mark]
...You look tired.
Since you went there you should take a day to rest.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
...你看起来很累。
既然去过那里，应该休息一天。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
I can't believe you want to enter a place like this again...
scripts.translation:
[马克]
真不敢相信你想再次进入这种地方...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Verity, are you alright?
You do not look good...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
薇丽蒂，你没事吧？
你看起来气色不好...

scripts.text:
[Du]
I have a bad feeling about this...
scripts.translation:
[杜]
我对这里有种不好的预感...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Umph...I suddenly have a feeling that's not good.
I wish to talk with the leader.
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
唔...我突然有一种不好的感觉。
我想和首领谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Umph...I suddenly have a feeling that's not good.
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
唔...我突然有一种不好的感觉。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Something is splitting my head....Ugh....
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
有什么东西在撕裂我的头...呃...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
....Ugh....

[Du]
Sister! Are you alright?!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
姐姐！你没事吧？！

scripts.text:
[Verity]
....Have to go back....
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
...必须回去...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Verity, are you alright?
Can you walk?
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
薇丽蒂，你没事吧？
你能走路吗？

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
呃...

scripts.text:
[Du]
{0}! I think it is better that you go back.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
{0}！我觉得你最好先回去。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
N...no. I will catch up soon so go on ahead.
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
不...不行。我马上就能追上，你先走吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then I will stay with Verity until she recovers so you can go on ahead.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
那我就留下来陪薇丽蒂直到她恢复，你先走吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Huff huff... Verity suddenly huff huff couldn't even stand straight before huff huff...
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
呼...呼...薇丽蒂突然呼...呼...连站都站不稳了呼...呼...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I don't think this is a problem we can solve by talking amongst ourselves.
Let's ask the leader's opinion first.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
我觉得这不是我们私下商量就能解决的问题。
先去问问首领的意见吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Ran off so fast huff...huff... to even catch up. Huff huff
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
跑得那么快呼...呼...连追上都很吃力。呼...呼...

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Uh... Could Verity have gone that far?
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
呃...薇丽蒂真的能跑那么远吗？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
We need to find Verity quickly
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
我们需要尽快找到薇丽蒂。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
There is only the route going up so go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
只有往上走的路，你先去吧。

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Ah...Where am I..
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
啊...我在哪里...
发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Verity]
My head...is splitting.
A sound coming from this...door...
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
我的头...要裂开了。
这扇...门里...传来声音...

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Go inside.
scripts.translation: 进去看看

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Go back...we have to go back...
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
回去...我们必须回去...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Quickly...we have to go back...
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
快...我们必须回去...

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Finally.. We came back...
Finally.....
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
终于...我们回来了...
终于.....

scripts.text:
[Verity]
Who am I?
Who am I...
scripts.translation:
[薇丽蒂]
我是谁？
我是谁...
